# Going Endo

> Going Endo works with businesses and industry partners to apply emerging technologies to meaningful challenges and strengthen the industries they depend on.

Going Endo LLC is an independent emerging technology education and innovation company based in Salt Lake City, Utah, built to work with industries internationally. The name means "going within": working inside companies and industries rather than apart from them.

## Status

Going Endo is preparing to launch and is inviting its first industry partners.

## Who it works with

Companies, industry associations, economic development organizations, universities, and research institutions.

## What it does

1. Identify challenges: find problems worth solving across an industry.
2. Bring people together: connect businesses with technology experts, researchers, and regional partners.
3. Apply technology: develop and test practical solutions.
4. Measure results: evaluate business performance and broader economic value.

Technologies include artificial intelligence, automation, data, energy technologies, and other emerging technologies relevant to the industry.

## What it is not

- Not a technology news website.
- Not a generic AI training company.
- Not a conference business built on one time events.
- Not a broad consultancy claiming to solve every problem.

Education and events support the work. The work is applying technology to real challenges.
